limits: The candidate is isolated and is not installed, submitted, reviewed, or merged upstream.
Docker uses the software Vulkan llvmpipe adapter; no Docker hardware WGPU or NVIDIA CUDA was available.
The new Mac candidate run confirms Metal compute and no OGRE2 crash, but does not add a new ROS payload capture because the host ROS CLI observer stalled after the Homebrew dependency change.
Intentional bounded SIGINT termination can report child exit -2; one CPU/combined shutdown also showed parameter_bridge -11 after functional evidence was already captured.
General acoustic correctness, backend numerical equivalence, long-duration stability, and real-vehicle behavior remain outside this candidate validation.
